title: City By The Coast [2K]
description:
Fantastic view of the sunset, ocean, and the city from a mountain.

Took me a while to find another wallpaper that I like, so here it is. Probably not as time consuming as the other wallpapers I have made recently (at least compared to Neon Skyline), although all of my wallpapers are simple to make so they don't take much time anyway to do, but hopefully it still looks good.

Also special thanks to those who helped me in improving the wallpaper especially Drioyard, who gave me tips for the lens flare.

Edit 1: Wow, this wallpaper finally hit 50,000 downloads! I never thought that one of my wallpapers would get so popular, especially since this wallpaper actually got dislike botted a few weeks ago which completely halted the sub growth. The fact that it got popular again is basically a miracle in itself. 

So yeah, thank you guys so much for downloading and enjoying this wallpaper and my other works too. Also a big thank you to the artists who drew the artworks, without them the live wallpapers that I make would not be possible to animate.

Music:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UxRRfUyluJU] AK - I Can't Sleep Anymore [/url]

Wallpaper can be found [url=https://www.deviantart.com/joeyjazz/art/Sunset-v2-0-735900479] here [/url] (made by JoeyJazz)

Ambience sounds from Zapsplat.com

Update 1: Adjusted opacity of fogs and added another fog

Update 2: Added option to disable parallax and adjusted pulse

Update 3: Added shooting stars and option to disable it

Update 4: Adjusted parallax depth for lens flare

Update 5: Increased size of tree to cover up uhhh errors in the wallpaper

Update 6: Changed parallax depth for sakura leaves

Update 7: Adjusted parallax depth for lens flares

Update 8: Adjusted water ripples for ocean

Update 9: Adjusted fog properties and increased size of tree

Update 10: Adjusted ocean movement

Update 11: Adjusted lake movement

Update 12: Adjusted cloud movement
